# The Last Click

> The Last Click is an independent game studio based in Greece. We create BoomBoats, DADLINE: Family Rush and ShipDuel.

## Studio
Beyond the click. A new chapter of play.
Legal name: THE LAST CLICK L.P. · Maroussi, Greece.

## Games
- BoomBoats: naval strategy in a voxel ocean. Out now on iOS and Android.
  - iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/boomboats-naval-battleship/id6794503743
  - Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.jimtsip.boomboats
- DADLINE: Family Rush: a comic-book running adventure about family errands. Out now on iOS.
  - iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dadline-family-rush/id6802018413
- ShipDuel: pirate cannon duels and winning-streak decisions. Coming soon; no public download destination announced.
